acquisition.automatic: Start GPS and optional NMEA. Start network location after ten seconds without a usable fix, or immediately when GPS or precise permission is unavailable.
acquisition.network: Request only NETWORK_PROVIDER; do not subscribe to GPS or NMEA.
acquisition.completion: The first usable requested-provider callback or validated NMEA fix completes one acquisition.

validation.gps: Require the GPS provider, finite bounded coordinates, and a recent original elapsedRealtimeNanos timestamp.
validation.nmea: Validate the checksum, fix status, coordinates, message timestamp, and original UTC fix time.
validation.network: Require the network provider, finite bounded coordinates, positive bounded accuracy, a recent provider timestamp, and no mock flag or reported satellite source.
validation.unreported_radio_source: Accept the Android network-provider callback and label it Network provider without claiming a Wi-Fi or cell source.
validation.provider_limit: OEM services can rewrite timestamps or reuse coordinates; callback metadata alone cannot establish an independent fresh radio measurement.

lifecycle.late_callbacks: Generation checks suppress callbacks from completed or cancelled acquisitions.
lifecycle.mode_change: Cancel the previous acquisition or refresh generation and schedule an update using the selected mode.
lifecycle.failure: Keep the previous weather and retry after five minutes.
